name: Beneath the Surface
source:
Not every connection is what it seems.  

Step into the shoes of a devoted father. Your days are brightened by Maya, a kind and thoughtful young woman who becomes an essential part of your family. Her presence brings comfort and joy to you and his daughter, Lily. Yet, small moments hint at layers unseen, urging you to look deeper.

[From [url=https://ava-interactive.itch.io/beneath-the-surface]Itch[/url]]
